title: Qualify the F8 exit candidate on Linux
requires: Physical ThomasLaptop with Slang CPU, RTX 3050 Ti CUDA and Vulkan targets
scope: Qualify only the F8-93 replacement candidate from scratch on the registered Linux CPU, CUDA and Vulkan rows after F8-90--92 repair. Preserve candidate-v10 failures and require independent verdicts for all three installed runtimes.
acceptance: Bind exact source, installed SDK and driver manifests, CPU/GPU, OS, CUDA/Vulkan toolchains and candidate manifest hashes for each runtime variant.
Pass every applicable public case against the reviewed frozen reference in plain and validation modes, plus repeated-run comparisons for all previously unstable cases.
Pass advertised capabilities, all 12 scenarios, analytic quality, lifecycle/recovery, fixed-work assertions and negative controls without backend fallback or vendor-specific equations.

Complete the exact CPU and desktop workloads with declared warmup/measurement counts, zero failed ticks and every timing sample and stall retained. Timing misses route to F9 only after correctness passes.
Pass relocated installed SDK and Gallery lifecycle checks for CPU, CUDA and Vulkan and publish separate raw verdicts for each row.
Publish current revisioned CPU, CUDA and Vulkan capability evidence suitable for the generated public qualification index.
